Malt est la première plateforme de freelancing en Europe, avec une mission claire : offrir à chacun la liberté de choisir avec qui il travaille. Co-fondée en 2013 par Vincent Huguet, qui en est toujours le CEO, Malt est une entreprise tech à dimension humaine qui facilite la mise en relation entre freelances et entreprises pour créer le match parfait.

Malt, c’est une marketplace qui rassemble une communauté de plus de 850 000 freelances!


  • Une entreprise tech à dimension humaine

  • Un membre FrenchTech Next40

  • une culture forte portée par 700 Malters de 40+ nationalités, répartis dans 9 pays en Europe : Allemagne, Belgique, Émirats Arabes Unis, Espagne, France, Pays-Bas, pays nordiques, Royaume-Uni et Suisse

  • un engagement pour un environnement de travail sûr et inclusif, où chacun peut s’épanouir personnellement et professionnellement

  • une volonté d’égalité et de diversité (50% des managers sont des femmes)

  • une politique de développement des carrières permettant à tous les Malters de grandir et d’évoluer équitablement

    • le soutien d’investisseurs de renom, dont ISAI, Serena, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs et BPI France

    🚀 Rejoignez-nous sur la Planète Malt, nous avons besoin de vous pour écrire le prochain chapitre !

    Chez Malt, nous croyons que l’ambition ouvre la voie au succès. C’est pourquoi les listes de missions et de responsabilités ne sont jamais figées ni exhaustives.

     

    Tu veux monter en compétences sur la vente B2B, découvrir le monde du freelancing et contribuer à des projets à impact dans le secteur public ?

    Ce stage est une opportunité unique d’évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et très formateur. 

     
     

    Rejoins l’équipe Commerciale de Malt, leader du freelancing en France, et participe activement au cycle de vente : de la prospection à la fidélisation des clients. Accompagne les administrations publiques à la recherche des meilleurs freelances pour leurs projets stratégiques.

    Le secteur public façonne notre quotidien : éducation, santé, écologie, transports, etc. Ce stage te permettra de contribuer à l’innovation et à l’agilité de ces services essentiels grâce au freelancing.

    Chez Malt, tu rejoindras une équipe d’experts des fonctions sales et du secteur public où tu seras rapidement responsabilisé et formé.

    Ensemble, transformons le monde du travail.

     

  • Prospecter et décrocher des rendez-vous via cold call et outils de prospection (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Salesloft, Salesforce, etc.).

  • Développer et entretenir un réseau de freelances afin de générer des opportunités commerciales.

  • Analyser les besoins clients et proposer des solutions adaptées.

  • Assister aux rendez-vous clients et suivre les opportunités avec ton Key Account Manager.

  • Soutenir les négociations et la gestion des appels d’offres.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes produit et commerciale pour optimiser les processus internes.

    •  
     

  • Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, stage 6 mois dès juillet 2026.

  • Esprit chasseur : prospecter, convaincre et conclure te motivent.

  • Orienté(e) résultats, à l’aise avec les objectifs commerciaux.

  • Une première expérience en vente B2B et une appétence pour le secteur public est  un plus.

  • Excellentes compétences relationnelles pour échanger avec clients et freelances.

  • Autonome, structuré(e), capable de gérer plusieurs priorités.

    •  
     

    1. Un leader du freelancing en pleine croissance, au cœur de la transformation  du secteur public.

    2. Une véritable école de vente : formation continue, gestion du cycle de vente, négociation et stratégie grands comptes.

    3. Un environnement exigeant et formateur pour apprendre vite et monter en compétences.

    4. Un impact réel en aidant les acteurs publics à innover grâce aux meilleurs freelances et en contribuant activement à la transformation du monde du travail.

    5. Rejoignez une équipe ambitieuse et bienveillante, où l’entraide, l’autonomie et la joie de réussir ensemble font toute la différence !

    6. Un tremplin vers un CDI : si tu performes et que tu t’épanouis dans ton rôle, l’aventure peut se poursuivre !

    • Entretien (30 min) avec Sarah pour échanger sur ton parcours et tes ambitions.

    • Entretien (45 min) avec des membres de l’équipe Secteur Public pour discuter du rôle en détail.

    • 30 minutes Interview in person with the VP of the Public Sector.
     

    Malt est l'espace parfait pour s'épanouir personnellement et professionnellement 💫

    • Onboarding : Avant de vous installer dans votre nouveau rôle, vous passerez votre première semaine à découvrir notre culture, nos produits et nos services avec d'autres nouveaux arrivants dans nos bureaux à Paris.

    • Congés payées : 1 jour d'absence payé par mois travaillé pour les stagiaires.

    • Tickets restaurant : 9€/jour sur votre carte Swile.

    • Transport : Remboursement à hauteur de 50% (tous types de transport).

    • Livres gratuits : Si vous souhaitez en savoir plus sur un sujet en lien avec l’activité de Malt, il vous suffit de nous indiquer les livres que vous aimeriez lire, et nous les commanderons pour vous — sans poser de questions ni de processus d’approbation à suivre.

    • Télétravail : Politique hybride de télétravail.

    • Événements annuels de team building.

southparkcommons-junior-ai:ashbyhq:d4a14.descriptionHtml:
👶 About Junior

We're building cutting-edge LLM-powered tools that supercharge investment research for the world's most demanding deal teams. Our clients include several of the top 10 global private equity firms, Big 4 professional services firms, and leading consulting practices: organisations responsible for deploying billions of dollars annually.

We're a profitable, bootstrapped company with a growing team of ~30 people based in London and New York. We 10x'd our revenue in 2025 and are on track to grow 2-3x again this year. Junior saves clients an average of 10 hours per week, and we're expanding fast into new verticals including investment banking, hedge funds, and research firms.

💡 Role Description

We’re hiring our third Product Manager to own the core research workflow and a help build a product team to build 0-1 add-on products. This is a high-ownership individual contributor role: you’ll run the day-to-day product execution loop - aligning with Customer Success, users, engineering and design on specs and tradeoffs, driving QA, and shipping frequently. The right person will have an opportunity to grow into a leadership role as the company grows.

✅ What you’ll do

  • Own the roadmap and execution for the core research workflow

  • Work closely with Customer Success and users to understand workflows, pain points, and what “great” looks like

  • Partner with Engineering + Design to prioritize, scope, and ship quickly

  • Drive QA and release readiness: testing plans, bug triage, launch checklists, and iteration plans

  • Keep stakeholders aligned (founders, engineering, design, CS) through lightweight, high-signal communication

  • Join sales and CS calls to demo the product and new features, explain capabilities clearly, and translate customer needs into product priorities

📈 What success looks like

  • Shipping velocity increases (more high-quality releases, faster iteration loops) - goal is to ship 1 major new feature per week

  • Adoption of new features and modules improves (users discover them, use them, and keep using them)

  • Customer responsiveness improves (faster feedback → clearer decisions → shipped fixes and improvements)

🔧 Sample set of projects

  • Interview guide generation: understand how teams create structured interview guides at the start of each project; define the right structure and workflow; work with design / engineering on an AI-assisted guide creation experience; iterate with users on prototype, roll out, drive awareness, and measure usage.

  • Live transcription: work with users and CS to validate the need for faster transcript access and higher visibility during calls; align with engineering on feasibility and approach; partner with design on how to surface live transcripts; pilot with early users, plan rollout, and track usage metrics.

  • Call anonymization: work with consulting clients and CS to surface current process of manually creating anonymized versions of transcripts; define what specific parts must be anonymized; partner with design/engineering to implement the anonymization flow make it easily discoverable / intuitive - then run customer testing, QA the release, launch, and track adoption/usage.

🔥 About You

  • 5+ years of experience shipping B2B SaaS products in fast-moving teams

  • Strong product execution: make good tradeoffs, unblock teams, focus on MVP and ship often

  • You’re close to customers and comfortable working directly with users and senior stakeholders. You will be selling products.

  • You’re a builder: you’re happy to get into the details and use Claude Code / Codex to make tweaks.

  • You prefer low ceremony / high accountability and avoid process-for-process’ sake

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • NYC-based and excited to work 5 days per week in-office

  • Bonus but not required: you have worked in a large consulting firm in the past

🌵 Benefits

All the usual benefits (competitive pay and equity, private healthcare etc). Unusual benefits:

  • Gym membership

  • In-office cook

  • Summers working in Greece by the beach

verdane-caia-cosmetics:teamtailor:31b6da.title: Sales Associates & Make Up Artists to CAIA Copenhagen Store
verdane-caia-cosmetics:teamtailor:31b6da.descriptionHtml:
Sales Associates & Make Up Artists — CAIA Copenhagen Store
Copenhagen, Denmark | Full-time, part-time & extra

About CAIA

CAIA Cosmetics was founded by Bianca Ingrosso in 2018. We're a high-quality beauty brand built on the belief that beauty should be accessible to all. Our products are crafted with care, designed for effortless use, and made with the finest ingredients from world-renowned factories.

The role

CAIA is opening its first store in Denmark — Copenhagen, August 2026. The space is 230 square metres across two floors, and we're now looking for a team that will make this store a success.

We're looking for Sales Associates and Make Up Artists who love helping customers find what works for them, building real relationships, and enjoy taking responsibility for their work. If meeting people energizes you and you're the type who steps up without being asked, you'll fit right in at CAIA.

What you'll do

  • Help customers find what works for them — through good listening, honest recommendations, and solid product knowledge.

  • Hit your sales targets and take ownership of the store's numbers, together with your team.

  • Keep the store looking its best. Tidiness and detail are part of the job, not an afterthought.

  • Show up as a team player — covering for each other, sharing what you know, and making the shift better for everyone around you.

What we're looking for

  • 3-5 years of experience in retail and customer service.

  • Someone who genuinely likes people and is comfortable on the floor.

  • Product curiosity. You don't need to know everything, but you need to want to.

  • Accountability. You do what you say you'll do.

  • Flexibility — working evenings, weekends, and holidays are part of the role.

  • Fluency in Danish and English.

  • A background as a Make Up Artist is a strong plus for some of these roles, but not a requirement across the board.

Practical information

We're looking to move quickly — recruitment starts in early June and roles begin in early August. You'll need to be available from the last week of July for introduction. If that works for you, don't wait to apply.

What we offer

  • Thorough onboarding and product training before we open the doors.

  • Competitive pay

  • Staff discounts

Apply

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply as soon as you're ready.

yc-zip:ashbyhq:16992e97-f14f-4aba-91d4-4.descriptionHtml:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a part of Zip's Engineering, Product, & Design recruiting team, you will be responsible for the building blocks of the company. As a Technical Sourcer, you will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and helping screen candidates. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who is able to learn, move, and adapt quickly, and remains laser focused on both quality and strong results.

You Will

  • Effectively identify and attract Product & Design candidates

  • Source a large pipeline of high quality candidates across evergreen or high priority roles

  • Engage exceptional technical candidates, engage and vet them, and manage interviewing and hiring processes, keeping candidate experience top of mind

  • Partner with Zip’s leaders to define hiring needs and ideal candidate profiles

  • Partner closely with cross-functional team members to land successful

  • Track recruiting metrics and performance to continuously improve Zip's recruiting processes

 

Qualifications

  • 3+ years experience of engineering sourcing experience

  • Proven success sourcing for Product and Design roles

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to represent Zip’s story and value prop to top talent.

  • Highly proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented, thriving in ambiguity and a fast-moving startup environment.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, comfortable managing multiple requisitions and competing priorities simultaneously.

  • Strong experience working with ATS platforms; Ashby experience preferred.

 

Nice to Haves

  • Experience scaling recruiting in a high-growth startup.

  • Background in B2B SaaS and/or Fintech recruiting.

  • Previous experience managing both volume hiring and niche, senior-level searches.

 

The salary range for this role is $125,000 - $190,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

 

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Full health, vision & dental coverage

  • 🍽️ Catered lunches & dinners for in office employees

  • 🚍 Commuter benefit for in office employees

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

  • 💸 401k plan

 

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!
